remaining_limits: No automatic semantic contradiction detector or legal supersession decision was added. Multiple current assertions require source review.

Explicit supersession is a caller command, not an extraction field or verified legal conclusion. It requires same directed endpoints/type and identical project/tenant; atomic support is currently SQLite only. Unsupported adapters preserve the prior edge and return an error.
Historical invalidations were not undone or migrated. Previously lost assertions still need original-source review.
Only exact identical assertion, quote and source identity are deduplicated. Paraphrases may remain separate; semantic equivalence and complete recall are unqualified.

Live replay retained four concept assertions; it does not qualify all obligations, exceptions, amendments or dispersed normative premises. Some recovered requirements and negated assertions remain Event candidates with unresolved roles.
Type-label endpoint aliases and broader entity disambiguation remain an unqualified risk; the new prompt requires actual entity names but does not prove every endpoint meaning.
Real PDFs, multi-document precedence and timezone-normalized temporal queries need dedicated evaluation.
No new Laya/GLiNER model training, MLX acceleration or architectural qualification.
